title: Remove useless and buggy identifier computation
issue_title: Getting issue on module admin controller's render list in Prestashop V1.7.6.1 with existing data
issue_body:
Hello,

Currently I am getting issue on my module's admin controller render list page in Prestashop V1.7.6.1 while my controller's render list has some data.
After research, I found that I am getting this issue because I am not using $this->identifier name similar to $this->table name on module's admin controller page.
For example, my table name is 'product_review' and here I am using primary key as 'id_review' So in this case, I will define $this->identifier = 'id_review' on module admin controller.

In previous prestashop version (below V1.7.6.1), I don't have any issue like this but on current prestashop V1.7.6.1, I am getting a error -
"Notice: Undefined index: id_product_review"

Check this screenshot -  https://prnt.sc/ozmiwc

In Prestashop V1.7.6.1, you are always getting entity like -   'id_' . $table_name
So have you restrict it in current version 1.7.6.1 because you didn't mention anything like this before.

Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Create a table in module i.e. table name 'product_review' and set primary key in this table as 'id_review'
2. Create a module's admin controller and set 
   $this->identifier = 'id_review'
   $this->table = 'product_review'

Now while you will add any data in your table and when you see render list of your admin controller then you will get issue like "Notice: Undefined index: id_product_review"
https://prnt.sc/ozmiwc

Here if I used my primary key as 'id_product_review' then I will get no error. So It looks like It is mandatory to set table primary key same table name.

title: Fix modules translations files in theme erased by modules translations that are in modules folder
issue_title: Translations: Priority to apply module translations files in theme
issue_body:
**Describe the bug**
When we translate modules in theme, translations is not applied because modules translations replace module translations are in theme.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Copy modules/marketplace/translations/fr.php in themes/classic/modules/marketplace/translations/fr.php
2. Edit translations
3. Translations are not applied

**Additionnal information**
PrestaShop version: 1.7.5.2
PHP version: 7.2

The problem is in classes/Translate.php, function getModuleTranslation, variable $filesByPriority that takes themes directory translations before translations of modules directory, so themes translations are replaced :
`$filesByPriority = array(
                // Translations in theme
                _PS_THEME_DIR_ . 'modules/' . $name . '/translations/' . $iso . '.php',
                _PS_THEME_DIR_ . 'modules/' . $name . '/' . $iso . '.php',
                // PrestaShop 1.5 translations
                _PS_MODULE_DIR_ . $name . '/translations/' . $iso . '.php',
                // PrestaShop 1.4 translations
                _PS_MODULE_DIR_ . $name . '/' . $iso . '.php',
            );`

We fix like this:

`$filesByPriority = array(
                // PrestaShop 1.5 translations
                _PS_MODULE_DIR_ . $name . '/translations/' . $iso . '.php',
                // PrestaShop 1.4 translations
                _PS_MODULE_DIR_ . $name . '/' . $iso . '.php',
                // Translations in theme
                _PS_THEME_DIR_ . 'modules/' . $name . '/translations/' . $iso . '.php',
                _PS_THEME_DIR_ . 'modules/' . $name . '/' . $iso . '.php',
            );`

What do you think about this fix?

title: Fix shop URL with port in header HOST
issue_title: Shop url with port
issue_body:
**Describe the bug**

When a server send a request with an host with port in HTTPS, Prestashop don't found the shop and send a redirection to HTTP url.

For instance when ATOS send a validation to the controller of Franfinance module (and probably Atos / atos3x), his HTTP header is : 

HOST: www.my-prestashop.tld:443

Then the Shop::initialize method try to find in shop URL $host with Tools::getHttpHost() witch return www.my-prestashop.tld:443 BUT in our shop_url we have only "www.my-prestashop.tld" without the port.

The tricky bug is that not all Atos server send host with port, we think that it depend of the payment server... But when a payment is manage by this servers, a payment is done but the order is not created an validated on the backoffice (redirection is not followed).



**Reproduce this bug**

curl -I -H "Host: www.my-prestashop.tld:443" https://www.my-prestashop.tld/

Response headers : 
HTTP/1.0 301 Moved Permanently
Date: Wed, 05 Jun 2019 14:18:30 GMT
Server: Apache
Location: http://www.my-prestashop.tld/
Cache-Control: max-age=0
Expires: Wed, 05 Jun 2019 14:18:30 GMT
Connection: close
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8


Correct response will be status: 200


**Suggested Pull Request**

We suggest to do this modification on the initialize shop method : 

$host = Tools::getHttpHost(false, false, true);

We can do a pull request.

The third parameter ignore the port. And will return www.my-prestashop.tld as expedted the shop will be found in the database and a status 200 will be return.

But for those witch have a specific port to access to its PrestaShop and configure a shop url with a port we introduce a bug...
So we try to find a fix and verify if a user can specify his own port, but we found that a user can configure as shop domain:
www.my-prestashop.tld:443foobar
It looks like a validation is missing because port 443foobar is not valid.

So we suggest to add a PrestaShop configuration (or equivalent) to ignore port or not all over the Prestashop platform (default value ignore = true). After that, getHttpHost third option can be replace by the new configuration.

Other heavy solution is to manage port on shop url table with a specific column to manage port.

What do you think about this ?

**Additionnal information**
PrestaShop version: 1.6.x and 1.7.x
PHP version: All

All calls on webhook or API (native or through a front Controller) using a server sending HOST with optional port (https://developer.mozilla.org/fr/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Host )

title: Check if Combination id is set before deleting Associations from database to prevent accidentally removing all products without attributes from all carts
issue_title: Combination::deleteAssociations deletes all cart products without attributes if id not set
issue_body:
From time to time the contents of most of the shopping carts in our store would be cleared without any apparent reason, affecting sales for a few days everytime it happened (probably from disgruntled customers abandoning the site), and breaking the functionality of some modules that didn't expect an order's cart to be empty.

After putting loggers around any function that might edit a cart's contents, it turned out that the Combination::deleteAssociations function doesn't check if the id is set before removing all cart products with the id_product_attribute corresponding to that id, which means that it will remove all products without combinations if called incorrectly, like this:

    $combination = new Combination();
    $combination->deleteAssociations();

In our case it turned out that the AdvancedPack5 module was the one incorrectly calling this function. However, the interface should not allow this incorrect usage as the effect is completely unintended and hard to debug. Instead a check needs to be made inside Combination::deleteAssociations and the queries that remove data should only be called if the id is set (i.e. does not evaluate to 0).

PrestaShop version: 1.5 (all), 1.6 (all), 1.7 (all) 
PHP version: N/A

title: Execute displayAdminLogin hook without shop context
issue_title: Error with hook displayAdminLogin
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

### BUG 1
**Describe the bug**
Hook `displayAdminLogin` is not in table `ps_hook`, so a module can not be hooked manually in this position unless you call `registerHook` function.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Install module dummymodule_v1.zip
[dummymodule_v1.zip](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/files/3216911/dummymodule_v1.zip)
2. Go to "Design -> Positions -> Insert a module"
3. Can't be hooked to 'displayAdminLogin` because this position doesn't appear
4. Uninstall and remove module
5. Install module dummymodule_v2.zip
[dummymodule_v2.zip](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/files/3216910/dummymodule_v2.zip)
6. Go to "Design -> Positions"
7. Module is hooked to `displayAdminLogin`. You can unhook and hook module because now position is at `ps_hook` table.

**Hook `displayAdminLogin` should be inserted in `ps_hook` table in installation.**

**Additinnal information**
PrestaShop version: 1.7.6

### BUG 2
**Describe the bug**
Hook is linked with "multishop" and it shouldn't. It should be executed always, doesn't matter the shop context.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Create a multishop with 2 stores
2. Go to "Modules -> Catalog manager"
3. Select the store with ID 2 in the store selector
4. Install module dummymodule_v2.zip
[dummymodule_v2.zip](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/files/3216910/dummymodule_v2.zip)
5. Open BO login page in an Incognito tab
6. Hook `displayAdminLogin` is not executed
8. Uninstall module
9. Select the store with ID 1 in the store selector
10. Install module dummymodule_v2.zip
11. Reload the previous BO login page opened
12. Hook `displayAdminLogin` is executed (appears a string `Dummy module` under the login box)

Hook is only executed if you install module in "All shops" context or in Multistore ID 1, while in BO login page there is not a shop context yet. Query that retrieves module hooks for hook `displayAdminLogin` should not take into consideration shop context.

**Additional information**
PrestaShop version: 1.7.6
